sources.entry: XtraFinder - Adds tabs and cut to Mac Finder. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: XtraFinder
summary.one_liner: XtraFinder is a macOS add-on that adds tabs, dual-panel browsing, cut-and-paste and other extras to the Finder.
use_cases: Browse multiple folders in tabs inside Finder
Move files on macOS using cut and paste
Work with files side by side in dual panels
Queue up multiple copy or move operations
Open a terminal at the current Finder folder
summary.what_it_does: XtraFinder adds tabbed and dual-panel file management to macOS Finder. It adds a Command+X cut and Command+P paste workflow, which Finder lacks natively. A copying queue lets users start multiple copy, cut, or paste operations without waiting for earlier ones to finish. It also offers quick commands such as Copy Path, New Terminal Here, Compress/Expand, and Delete permanently, plus display options like folders kept on top and auto-sized columns.
notable: Cut (Command+X) and paste (Command+P) for moving files in Finder
Tabs and dual-panel browsing inside Finder
Copying queue for overlapping file operations
Quick commands such as New Terminal Here and Copy Path
caveats: Page does not state a version, compatibility range, or system requirements.
Listing describes it as freeware, but the page text itself does not state pricing terms.
